41.exact_result: Draft proof of local decreasing strict semipositive real-PL sequences for arbitrary classical psh functions on separated smooth boundaryless second-countable strict analytic curves over complete nontrivially valued fields, and consequently for every arbitrary classical psh function defined on a full projective bundle over an ordinary open subset of a smooth separated algebraic curve over a field with a countable dense subset. Includes minus-infinity values, finite separable mesh realization, strict descent, one fixed neighbourhood, termwise chart overlaps, and pullback through every analytic scalar extension. This is a saturated-domain higher-dimensional sector, not the full arbitrary-germ characterization.
concrete_gaps: No sharp characterization or necessity/failure range for arbitrary classical psh germs in dimension at least two.
The fibre argument needs the whole compact projective fibre; arbitrary functions on nonsaturated affine/open fibre charts are not covered.
Smooth normal unibranch examples do not establish sufficiency of normality or unibranchness alone.
No general strict PL descent through nonflat singular-curve or higher-dimensional normalization is proved.
No unrestricted non-second-countable extraction for arbitrary new starting functions, or genuine analytic counterexample to sequential regularization, is provided.
Boundary geometry and general tropical-chart overlap gluing outside the proved sector remain unresolved.

42.exact_result: For complete algebraically closed nontrivially valued K, arbitrary classical psh targets on boundaryless algebraic curve domains have fixed-neighborhood decreasing LFS nets, and sequences when K is countably dense. Pullback and proper-fibre constancy give the same for all targets defined on saturated projective bundles and proper-factor products. An uncountable residue field gives a sharp sequence obstruction for the boundary spike on a closed disc and its projective-space products; the spike has an explicit LFS sequence for countable residue and a net in general.
concrete_gaps: No necessary-and-sufficient characterization of higher-dimensional good strict spaces for the full arbitrary classical psh starting class.
The sufficient sector requires targets defined on saturated neighborhoods; arbitrary nonsaturated local germs are not handled.
No general nonclosed-field descent of the newly constructed interpolants and fixed perturbation.
No sequence extraction for arbitrary fresh targets over fields lacking a countable dense subset; only nets are proved there.
The boundary obstruction is sharp for its particular function and distinguishes sequences from nets; it does not establish the full failure range.
